project_name: DOE Oak Ridge Reservation AI data center and energy projects
aliases: Oak Ridge Reservation AI infrastructure RFP
status_detail: DOE issued a September 30, 2025 RFP seeking private proposals to build and power AI data centers at the Oak Ridge Reservation; Roane County's official page says the reservation was selected for high-capacity AI data centers paired with on-site clean energy generation. No selected private partner, final lease, local building permit, construction start, or energization evidence was located in this quick pass.
notes: County/local news separately shows Roane commissioners asked the regional planning commission for a two-year pause on data centers in July 2026; that moratorium action is not project approval.

status_detail: Greater Memphis Chamber reported that xAI reached full operational capability for Phase I at the former Electrolux site by May 1, 2025 and was receiving 150 MW from new MLGW/TVA Substation #63, with 150 MW of Megapack batteries. Shelby County Health Department later approved a construction permit for fifteen permanent natural-gas backup turbines serving the facility.
notes: Capacity is grid service reported by chamber/MLGW/TVA context, not necessarily IT load. Environmental/legal challenge sources indicate contested turbine permitting history.

project_name: xAI Southwest Memphis / Colossus expansion property
status_detail: Greater Memphis Chamber announced on March 7, 2025 that xAI purchased a one-million-square-foot property in Southwest Memphis to complement existing operations and support the Colossus expansion; the same article references an $80 million Colossus Water Recycling Plant at Frank C. Pidgeon Industrial Park and Megapack deployment. No local building permit or energization record for the second site was verified in this quick pass.
notes: Kept separate from Colossus Phase I because the chamber described a newly acquired million-square-foot Southwest Memphis property as an additional facility.

project_name: Aphorio Carter Collierville Enterprise Data Center
aliases: FedEx World Technology Center Campus enterprise data center
status_detail: Carter Funds announced on November 9, 2023 that Aphorio Carter acquired a fully leased enterprise data center in Collierville for about $13 million; Carter's portfolio page says it is a mission-critical corporate data processing center on 4.62 acres with more than 86,000 sq ft, 41,000 sq ft raised floor, and 10 MW of generator backup.
notes: Capacity_mw records backup generator capacity, not IT load; built in 2001 and acquired by Aphorio Carter in 2023.

status_detail: Upper Cumberland Electric Membership Corporation reported on May 20, 2025 that site preparation had begun for a data center across the road from its Monroe substation near Livingston, projected to be operational in summer 2025. UCEMC said the data center is not owned or operated by UCEMC and that its power supply can be reduced or interrupted during peak-reduction events.
notes: Livingston is in Overton County, but UCEMC serves Smith County and the prompt county is Smith; location/county boundary should be verified before canonical ingestion. Included because the Smith County search surfaced this nearby/UCEMC service-area project.
